partyFormation: CLOSE: EVERYONE MARCHES IN DA LEADER'S FOOTSTEPS, ONE TILE APART!
LOOSE: DEY WANDER AN' LIVE DEY OWN LIVES AROUND YA. SPRINT FOR TWO SECONDS TA FORM DA COLUMN; DEY REGROUP AFTER A BATTLE OR A MAP CHANGE. FACE ONE AN' PRESS OK TA TALK!
enemySpawnMode: DISTANCE FROM SPAWN: DA DIFFICULTY COMES FROM DA PLACE, NOT FROM YA. LEVELS RISE DA FURTHER A TILE IZ FROM WHERE YA STARTED. EACH NATION AN' BIOME HAS ITS OWN ROSTER, AN' EVERY TILE HIDES A BOSS!
PARTY LEVEL: ENEMIES MATCH YA PARTY. ROAMERS STAY AT OR BELOW YA LEVEL; EACH TILE HIDES ONE BOSS ABOVE IT. DA SAFEST OPTION!
BIOME: ANYTHIN' LIVIN' 'ERE CAN TURN UP, ANY LEVEL UP TA 100, ALL JUST AS LIKELY. DA PLACE DECIDES WHAT YA MEET, NEVER HOW HARD IT IZ!
CHAOS: LEVELS 1-110 ROAM ANYWHERE, ANY BIOME. PROCEDURAL MAPS DEAL DEY MONSTERS AGAIN ON EVERY ENTRY!
musicArtistDisplay: FIRST TIME: ANNOUNCED ONLY DA FIRST TIME YA HEAR A TRACK. CHANGIN' DIS SETTIN' RESETS WHAT IT REMEMBERS!
EVERY TIME: A LABELLED TAPE SLIDES IN WHENEVER DA TRACK COMES BACK. NEVER IN A FIGHT, NEVER TWICE INSIDE FIVE MINUTES!
MINIMAL: DA TRACK AN' ITS ARTIST IN DA USUAL CORNER NOTIFICATION!
